In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.

The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.
